type: confirmatory robustness diagnostic on a FAILED candidate
headline: Run exposed a calibration defect in the CPCV gate. As-run PBO 0.5909 (fail) was an artifact of odd-grid bias; tie-corrected PBO 0.3864 (pass) on identical data. Pre-registered 85% expectation of fail was WRONG.

corrected.recomputedFrom: stored equity curves, no new engine runs

defect.description: Odd config counts always admit an exact-median rank (omega=0.5, logit=0); logit<=0 counted it as overfit, biasing PBO upward.
defect.discoveredBy: null-distribution check: pure noise must centre PBO on 0.5

config.grid: n in {5,7,9} (INHERITED from batch-1 locked config, not chosen)

limits: Window 2008-2025 differs from batch-1s 2000-2025, so this does NOT validate the 0.298 ret/DD estimate; over 2008-2025 n=7 gives 0.371
CPCV ranks on block total return, not risk-adjusted return; configs span DD 14.0%-29.5%
M=3 grid is coarse (ranks 1-3 only), low power
consequences: 025 remains a FAIL; locked goals never reopened
Phase-14 acceptance claim (Double7 PBO 0.73) was overstated: 3-config null was 0.671
the near-miss-equals-parameter-noise policy proposed in the 073 report is WITHDRAWN
all prior odd-grid CPCV numbers must be read against an inflated null
